requestBody: Faka idilesi ye-imeyile oyisebenzisela i-Vaultara. Siza kukuthumelela ikhonkco lokuqinisekisa. Akukho nto icinywayo de uqinisekise.
sentBody: Ukuba ikhona iakhawunti ye-Vaultara esebenzisa le dilesi, siyithumelele ikhonkco lokuqinisekisa. Ikhonkco liphelelwa lixesha kwiyure e-1. Ukuba akukho nto ifikayo, jonga isiqulathi seposi engafunekiyo.
item4: Amakhonkco akho okwabelana, amakhonkco ekhalenda nobulungu bekhaya
subscriptionNote: Ukucima iakhawunti yakho akurhoxisi ubhaliso. Lurhoxise kwi-Google Play okanye kwi-App Store ukuze ungahlawuliswa kwakhona.
doneBody: Iakhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara nedatha yayo zicinyiwe. Ungalivala eli phepha.
donePendingBody: Siqalile ukucima iakhawunti yakho. Kungathatha iiyure ezimbalwa ukugqiba. Ungalivala eli phepha.
failed: Kukho into engahambanga kakuhle. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uze uzame kwakhona.
rateLimited: Izinzame ezininzi kakhulu. Linda kancinci uze uzame kwakhona.
expiredBody: Amakhonkco asebenza iyure e-1. Faka i-imeyile yakho kwakhona ukuze ufumane elitsha.
usedBody: Le akhawunti isenokuba sele icinyiwe. Ukuba usenayo iakhawunti, cela ikhonkco elitsha.
invalidBody: Ikhonkco lisenokuba alipheleli. Livule kwakhona kwi-imeyile okanye ucele elitsha.
step1: Faka ngezantsi idilesi ye-imeyile oyisebenzisela i-Vaultara.
step3: Jonga iinkcukacha uze uqinisekise. Emva koko iakhawunti yakho iyacinywa.
inApp: Ungacima iakhawunti yakho nakwi-app ye-Vaultara: Iprofayile, emva koko Ukhuseleko nobumfihlo, emva koko Cima iakhawunti.
keptBody: Akukho nto yimbi egcinwayo kwi-Vaultara. Iikopi zingahlala kwiikopi zogcino lwe-Google Cloud iiveki ezimbalwa de kubhalwe ezinye iinkcukacha phezu kwazo. Iirekhodi umthetho ofuna sizigcine, ezifana neerekhodi zerhafu, zigcinwa kuphela ixesha elifunwa ngumthetho. I-Google Play ne-Apple zigcina ezazo iirekhodi zezinto ozithengileyo.
